original_description: RiffAds makes UGC-style video ads. Pick an AI actor, give it a script, and get a finished talking actor video for your product. It also makes images, short videos, voice-overs and music for the same campaign. Attach a product photo or a clip in the chat to use it. Edit what you make too: add captions, remove a background, trim, resize, change the voice or put text on it. Every result is saved to your RiffAds workspace library with a permanent link, and a player shows it right in the chat. Open the RiffAds Studio from the sidebar or beside a chat to browse everything you made, pick a file to use, choose an actor, a voice and the settings, and follow running jobs. RiffAds asks you before it starts any work and never posts anything to a social network.
summary_ja: AI出演者を使った動画広告と画像・音声の制作や編集。
limitations: 処理開始前に確認し、SNSには投稿しないと説明。動作は未検証。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
